name: Cauldron of the Vermintoll Coven

source.note: Fabled Heirloom from the Crooked Nightmare; the book's numbers, our words. Its Tiny-to-Medium size change, Cookpot and Fortifying Gorge (camp meals) wait on the camp screen.

summary: A big iron pot the coven cooked in: a spellcasting focus that adds +1 to all saving throws (+2 at level 7, +3 at 13), and Vermincall (Conjure Animals as vermin) once a dusk. Its size change and its camp meals wait on the camp screen.

powers.name: Vermincall
powers.text: Conjure Animals as a swarm of insects or rats.
